Name: Chromie Wishlist
Description: Track useful instance loot, manage your wishlist and import AtlasLoot wishlists. Includes loot alerts and custom sounds. Requires AtlasLoot.

Name: LootRolls (LootSummary)
Description: Retail-style loot window with active rolls, player decisions and session history. Installed as LootSummary; open it in game with /ls.

Name: Chromie Crafting
Description: Track account professions, recipes and materials on ChromieCraft.

Name: ChromiePlanner
Description: Plan equipment upgrades and character progression on ChromieCraft.

Name: WeakAuras (WotLK)
Description: WotLK backport with options, templates, archive, model paths and stop-motion textures. Protected APIDocumentation is not installed.

Name: Grid2 (WotLK)
Description: Raid frames with configuration and area-of-effect healing modules for WotLK.

Name: Kui Nameplates (WotLK)
Description: WotLK nameplates and their aura module.

Name: Method Raid Tools (WotLK)
Description: Raid organization, notes and encounter tools backported to WotLK.

Name: Deadly Boss Mods (ChromieCraft)
Description: ChromieCraft/AzerothCore boss mods, raid/dungeon modules, timers and VEM voice pack. WorldEvents is excluded: its upstream TOC references a missing file. No existing addon is replaced automatically.

Name: Awesome CVar Manager
Description: Configure AwesomeWotLK CVars. Requires an already patched compatible client; no DLL or client patch is installed.

Name: Flash
Description: Flash the game window on important events. Requires AwesomeWotLK/FlashWindow client support, not installed by this addon.

Name: PlateCastBar (AwesomeWotLK)
Description: Nameplate cast bars, including non-targeted units with an already installed AwesomeWotLK client patch.

Name: BiS-Tooltip (WotLK)
Description: Best-in-slot equipment lists and tooltip information backported to WoW 3.3.5a.

Name: Auctionator (WotLK)
Description: Historical Auctionator 2.6.3 for buying, selling and scanning auctions on WotLK.

Name: Cheese (WotLK, fixed)
Description: Cataclysm-style spell proc alerts for WotLK, with upstream fixes.

Name: Minimap Button Frame
Description: Collect minimap addon buttons into a movable frame. Historical WotLK source.

Name: Minimap Button Frame Skin Pack
Description: Optional historical skin pack for Minimap Button Frame.

Name: Binder
Description: Historical Binder 2.1.0 keybinding profiles, preserved in a WotLK addon collection.

Name: NiceDamage (WotLK)
Description: Damage font replacement with a TOC declaring interface 30300. Different fonts/settings from other NiceDamage variants; replacement is manual.

Name: MySlot (historical WotLK)
Description: Historical MySlot 3.3 action bars/keybindings import/export. Does not include local custom profile features; replacing a customized copy discards those code changes.
